Israel

Position 010/2023: Delivery/Project manager – Global

For a successful startup in the field of financial services, we are looking for a Delivery/Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Support the implementation of a financial-organizational management system for existing and potential clients. 
  • Account Receivables: Consolidated AR reporting analysis (quarterly/monthly), aging, cash flow forecasting, bad debts provision monitoring, and credit insurance management. 
  • Interaction with end clients and stakeholders within the organization. 
  • Customer support and training in managing the collection processes within the system for all types of clients (HQ, Regions, subsidiary companies, key users, etc.). 
  • Customer portfolio management, interaction with end-users: implementation, training, and support. 
  • Responsible for compliance with regulations and policies when dealing with internal auditors, regulations, policies, and workflows. 

Requirements 

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business administration, accounting, or industrial engineering and management – mandatory. 
  • Excellent analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, attention to details, and interpersonal skills. 
  • Ability to manage and prioritize tasks. 
  • Computer skills: Proficiency in office, BI analytics, and web applications. 
  • Excellent written and spoken English and Hebrew. 
  • Good teamwork and positive team environment abilities. 
  • To succeed, it is crucial to be goal-oriented, meet deadlines, and possess excellent technical skills.

Postion 01/2024: Data Engineer - Microsoft Fabric & Azure ML Specialist

For a successful startup in the field of financial services, we are looking for a Data Engineer – Microsoft Fabric & Azure ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of top-tier machine learning models.
  • Harness data scraping techniques to extract invaluable insights.
  • Design algorithms that enhance data processing efficiency, focusing on optimizing working capital.
  • Deploy AI and ML models to bolster cash flow performance, underpinning data-driven decisions.
  • Stay updated with technological advancements, translating insights into innovative solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize machine learning applications for optimal performance and scalability.
  • Leverage expertise to create a 12-month sales forecast based on index trends, aiding strategic planning.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field; Master’s preferred.
  • Proven experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, with a focus on Azure ML.
  • Proficiency in data scraping tools and techniques.
  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in AI and ML.
  • Proficiency in SQL Server for database management and optimization.
  • Expertise in Azure Machine Learning for model development and deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory for data integration and ETL.
  • Proficiency as an Integration Developer with a deep understanding of Rest APIs.
  • Ability to create sales forecasts based on indices trends.
